title: GHC / MLF compiler shape classification benchmark
purpose: Compile identical generated shared-Haskell programs with GHC and with GHC-hosted MLF, from fresh targets to native executables. This classifies compiler behaviour by program shape; it is not the C/MLF Benchmarks Game comparison in tools/bench.

flat_functions.label: Independent annotated functions
flat_functions.work: n annotated top-level functions summed in a balanced tree

dependency_chain.label: Annotated dependency chain
dependency_chain.work: n annotated functions in a strict chain

inferred_chain.label: Inferred dependency chain
inferred_chain.work: the same chain with no signature on the generated functions

recursive_ring.label: Mutually recursive ring
recursive_ring.work: n functions in a mutually recursive cycle

poly_calls.label: Polymorphic Box calls
poly_calls.work: the same calls through a rank-1 forall

tree_chain.label: Skewed constructor tree
tree_chain.work: n leaves in a left-deep constructor tree

balanced_tree.label: Balanced constructor tree
balanced_tree.work: the same leaves in a balanced constructor tree

literal_table.label: Generated literal table
literal_table.work: a generated constructor table of n items

local_functions.label: Local let-bound functions (optional)
local_functions.work: flat functions placed inside one local let; never part of the default matrix

baseline.label: Minimal IO baseline
baseline.work: a program that only reads argv and prints it

default.description: 10 families x sizes 8, 32, 128 plus one minimal baseline; 31 cells, 186 timed compilations

smoke.description: Low-cost integrity and coverage check for ordinary PRs: 2 families at size 8 plus baseline; 3 cells, 18 timed compilations

crate-bootstrap-v1.summary: GHC-hosted shared-source bootstrap crate producer: --compile-crate (source to checked) then --crate-to-llvm-gc (checked to LLVM), then ordinary Clang -O2. This is NOT the installed emlf SOURCE -o driver.
crate-bootstrap-v1.driver: PRODUCER/bin/emlf --compile-crate SPEC -o UNIT; PRODUCER/bin/emlf --crate-to-llvm-gc UNIT.mlfci; clang -O2 UNIT.ll
crate-bootstrap-v1.cache_boundary: each leg gets a private, empty query cache directory that is inventoried and deleted after correctness checks; no target objects, .hi/.o files, LLVM or executables are reused between legs

emlf-source-v1.status: declared, not measured in this revision
emlf-source-v1.summary: Installed default emlf SOURCE -o OUTPUT driver with its native standard library. Different internal work from crate-bootstrap-v1 and therefore a separate cohort dimension.
emlf-source-v1.requires: a qualified native installation (tools/shared/build.py without --bootstrap-only) plus its own preparation step
emlf-source-v1.rule: cohorts of this endpoint must never be pooled, compared or relabelled against crate-bootstrap-v1 cohorts

claim_limits: Three repetitions per cell describe spread on one machine; they are not a confidence interval.
A single cohort cannot show that one compiler is faster in general, only the measured wall ratios for these fixtures.
Different cohorts are separate windows and are never pooled into one median.
